source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: z_floor=3.0m (single storey height) assumed pending elevation cross-check
Ceiling height 3.0m assumed pending elevation cross-check
Door/window head and sill heights assumed (door 2.1m, window sill 0.9m/head 2.1m, corridor window sill 1.0m) pending elevation evidence
partition_bottom_2 (building centerline) assumed to have no doors; rooms 2 and 3 each access the corridor via their single observed door near the outer partitions
No vertical circulation (stair) is shown in either plan view; floors are stacked at z_floor=3.0 without an inferred stair connection
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Exact partition/door pixel widths for the four bottom rooms were read from a single wide crop and mirrored by symmetry for rooms 3/4; not independently re-measured on that side
Interior door swing state (open/closed) unknown for all doors
No exterior ground-level entrance identified on this floor plan; access route (stair/lift) location is unresolved
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

legend.blue: declared wall faces; evidence status in metadata
legend.yellow: W# resolved wall-reference representative segment; full wall mapping in wall_evidence_projection
legend.red: D#:S original dimension start evidence point
legend.cyan: D#:E original dimension end evidence point

limits: Two caller-supplied anchors per axis define the transform but do not independently close a dimension chain.
The overlay does not inspect original pixels or automatically decide positional error.

scope.endpoint_selection: exact original image name and linked wall floor

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.
Tangential range and normal displacement are conditional on the caller-supplied axis-aligned calibration.
A dimension extension-line tick may legitimately lie outside its linked finite wall segment; this is a spatial fact, not an error or correctness verdict.
This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.
